notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native two-member available-advance timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. With HLA_EVOKED callbacks, a TARA grant equal to scheduled save time 5 leaves the request pending, while a later TARA grant 6 initiates the constrained member's save before its grant callback. The regulating member receives initiation after its own qualifying callback service, and both complete the save. Direct traceability is limited to four pinned requirement-section pairs in clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time using an adapter-supplied portable FOM. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. The per-recipient callback-service sequence is an experimental public observation, not a universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
